Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, I'm attaching a proposal that reorganizes the renewal into a co-term structure and introduces a staged ramp to align spend with your product rollout. High-level:

- Term: 36 months (Jan 1, 2027 — Dec 31, 2029) co-termed with your analytics purchase order
- Year 1: 50% committed capacity with a gentle ramp to 100% by Q4 2027
- Year 2: 100% baseline with option to add incremental dedicated capacity at pre-negotiated rates
- Auto-renew: annual auto-renew with 60-day opt-out window (we can make this mutual)

I've attached an excel with the ramp schedule and a draft mutual action plan. Price and discounting are in tab "Pricing v1".

Questions for you: is the Jan 1 start acceptable, and do you need any changes to the auto-renew language to satisfy your procurement/legal teams?

Next steps I suggest:
1) Procurement + legal review redlines (if any)
2) Finance confirms co-term invoice cadence
3) Sign & enable staging plan in our provisioning system

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

4) Need a single co-term invoice (quarterly) if possible — our AP team wants consolidated billing.

Draft ops plan attached (MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN-ELLC-2026.xlsx) and a quick timeline below that incorporates Samantha's asks:

- Start date: Feb 1, 2027 (provisioning snapshot on Jan 25)
- Q1 (Feb — Apr): 50% baseline, onboarding + monitoring
- Q2 checkpoint (May 1): joint review of usage & QPS; option to expand to 150% for a 90-day pilot (auto-scale enabled, cap at agreed pilot ceiling)

- Pre-approved parameter set for safety and latency SLOs
